amendment_reason: V01 produced no evaluation result and persisted zero corpus files because the sequential MediaWiki acquisition encountered HTTP 429 twice. V02 preserves the V01 scientific protocol exactly and changes only acquisition from per-title sequential requests to one batched MediaWiki request.

projection.unit: eligible MediaWiki section with normalized body length >= 120 characters
projection.identity: title + canonical heading path, with the live current-core logical identity resolver allowed to abstain
projection.document_shape: heading paths + block count + unit order
projection.artifacts: one section artifact per logical unit + one document index + deterministic four-bucket topic projections

claim_boundary: Prospective scientific protocol inherited unchanged from V01, with a pre-declared transport-only amendment after V01 was acquisition-blocked before any persisted corpus or performance result. Evidence scope remains the current typed-change-channel Core on a deterministic Wikipedia section projection; it is not OCR, ontology, legal/regulatory, or customer-data evidence.
